items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: He had Stanley come out to my house one night, Stanley Maddison.

ctx.x: He had Stanley come out to my house one night, Stanley Maddison. And, uh, I forget what we was playing. Zero. He says, y'all got this thing written? I said, no. He said, man, it sounds like you arranged it. You know, but it, I was playing it just like the standard. It should be played, you know? But, uh, most of these bands said, yeah, they play it. It's a tune even if it is a standard. Man, they just take off any way they want. And they're gonna sound like the standard. But I think a standard should be played…
